arms.single: 1 agent, extend own_last only (single chain, no backtrack) — the classic baseline + the HARD-floor definer
arms.single_restart: 1 agent; each round may root-restart (fresh) OR extend own_last — isolates backtrack/root-restart (1 agent)
arms.single_tree_no_price: 1 agent; may extend ANY of its OWN prior nodes (uniform, NO price) — isolates own-history tree search
arms.parallel: N independent chains, no shared tree/price — isolates more-samples / swarm
arms.parallel_restart: N independent chains + root-restart, no shared price — isolates multi-agent backtrack
arms.no_price: N agents, shared tree, RANDOM parent (price mechanism runs but does NOT route) — isolates non-locality vs price
arms.shuffled_price: N agents, shared tree, softmax over a PERMUTED price — isolates the PRICE SIGNAL vs the tree
arms.market: N agents; the harness FORCES each to a node by softmax over the loss-bearing price (Path-2, forced price-routing)
arms.autonomous: N agents; each reads the compact price landscape and FREELY chooses the parent (Path-1, free-choice). DECOUPLED: proof prompt byte-identical to market for the same parent

hard_floor_definition: a candidate theorem is CONFIRMED-HARD iff `single` solves 0/ALL-floor-seeds in THIS run. Cracks count ONLY on the confirmed-hard subset (the confound-shield: on a single-0 theorem, model capability + lucky-guess variance are flattened to a 0 floor, so a crack by another arm = the organization, not the model).
CRITICAL_FINDING_v3_floor_unreliable: The v4 validity smoke (2026-06-02, binary cb89a5d6) found `single` SOLVES lm_ineq1 (seed 1, axiom-clean proof, the SAME AM-GM route v3 credited to an autonomous 'crack'). `single` gets 24 attempts/cell (budget parity); a single success means its per-cell solve rate is high (a 0/3 cell triple is a ~5% fluke if the true per-cell rate is ~60%). So the v3 3-seed hard floor (single 0/3) was NOT robust — lm_ineq1 was never a confound-shield, and the v3 'autonomous cracked lm_ineq1 where single failed' was a small-sample artifact. CONSEQUENCE: the hard floor is re-established here with 6 floor-seeds; a theorem counts as hard ONLY if single solves 0/6. Likely a strong model (deepseek-v4-pro) solves many lm_ theorems, so the robustly-hard set may be small — which is itself an honest finding (the lm_ set may not be hard enough to shield model capability).
staged_run: STAGE A (hard-floor): single x 18 candidates x 6 floor-seeds -> H = {single 0/6}. STAGE B (crack): {market, autonomous, parallel, shuffled_price, no_price} x H x 6 crack-seeds, paired with single over (theorem,seed). STAGE C (topology, conditional on a STAGE-B signal): {single_restart, single_tree_no_price, parallel_restart} x H x 6. Don't spend the expensive arms on non-hard theorems.
solved_definition: omega_reached == a LeanJudge axiom-clean Verified (inline #print-axioms gate, real lean exit-0 + axiom-whitelist). NOT a token-scan; native_decide/sorry/hand-axiom are rejected.

PREREG_1_MARKET_HAYEK.claim: a loss-bearing price-routed market organization (market) solves hard theorems that single AND the control family cannot
PREREG_1_MARKET_HAYEK.CONFIRMED_WIN_per_theorem: hard_single_0 AND market_solved>=1 AND parallel==0 AND shuffled_price==0 AND no_price==0 AND replay_clean AND axiom_clean
PREREG_1_MARKET_HAYEK.support_test: paired one-sided exact McNemar, market vs {single, parallel, shuffled_price, no_price}, matched by (theorem,seed), Holm-Bonferroni over the 4 hypotheses, alpha=0.05
PREREG_1_MARKET_HAYEK.prior: in the confounded v3, market solved 0/18. If market stays 0, this is an HONEST NO for the Hayek forced-price-routing claim — reported as such, not hidden.

PREREG_2_AUTONOMOUS_FREECHOICE.claim: DECOUPLED free-choice routing (autonomous, Path-1) solves hard theorems that single + market + controls cannot — and the win is NOT the prompt-context confound (byte-identical proof prompt is enforced)
PREREG_2_AUTONOMOUS_FREECHOICE.CONFIRMED_WIN_per_theorem: hard_single_0 AND autonomous_solved>=1 AND market==0 AND parallel==0 AND no_price==0 AND prompt_byte_identical_selftest_pass AND replay_clean AND axiom_clean
PREREG_2_AUTONOMOUS_FREECHOICE.support_test: paired one-sided exact McNemar, autonomous vs {single, market, parallel, no_price}, Holm over 4, alpha=0.05
PREREG_2_AUTONOMOUS_FREECHOICE.decoupled_condition: the binary that produced the data (HEAD cb89a5d6) passes `--self-test` (sha(autonomous_stage2)==sha(market) AND != confound_b_control). Recorded as a prereq, not a per-cell field.
PREREG_2_AUTONOMOUS_FREECHOICE.note: do NOT use PREREG_1 (market) to back an autonomous result; they are separate hypotheses with separate confirmation rules (auditor mandate).

topology_decomposition_contrasts: single vs single_restart: backtrack/root-restart effect, 1 agent
single_restart vs single_tree_no_price: root-or-last vs own-history tree, 1 agent
single_tree_no_price vs parallel: single-agent tree vs multi-agent independent
parallel vs parallel_restart: backtrack effect, multi agent
parallel_restart vs no_price: independent chains vs shared tree (both no price)
no_price vs shuffled_price: random node vs shuffled-price node (both no real price signal)
shuffled_price vs market: shuffled vs REAL price (isolates the PRICE SIGNAL)
market vs autonomous: forced softmax vs LLM free-choice (isolates the ROUTER), proof context byte-identical

compute_parity.principle: proposal-parity (every arm gets 24 proof proposals/cell) with TRANSPARENT mechanism-cost accounting via telemetry. autonomous additionally makes 24 route calls (Stage-1); price arms additionally make up to 24 bear calls (skeptic short). These are recorded per arm, NOT hidden, and NOT discounted (route tokens are in the PPUT denominator).
compute_parity.secondary: report a cost-adjusted (per-total-token) solve rate alongside the raw solve rate; a crack must not be a token-budget artifact.

stats_3_layer.existence: at least one axiom-clean Verified proof by arm X on a confirmed-hard (single-0) theorem
stats_3_layer.reliability: per-arm per-theorem solve rate with exact Clopper-Pearson CI + a beta-binomial posterior; seed-level paired table
stats_3_layer.causal: ALL preregistered controls fail (0) AND arm X beats them under the paired one-sided exact McNemar + Holm; reported separately for PREREG_1 (market) and PREREG_2 (autonomous)

replay_gate: every counted cell must pass verify_chaintape (economic_state_reconstructed==true) ELSE excluded. Cracks must be both replay-clean AND axiom-clean.
断点续做: a cell with a manifest + a replay-clean report is skipped; the sweep is resumable. CAS preserved (KEEP_CAS=1) to extract + persist the actual proof text of any crack.
